before.exam_tip_html: When answering questions on energy needs, always state the formula: Total energy = BMR × PAL and show your working with correct units (kcal). If asked to explain why two people have different energy needs, compare their age, gender, body size, and activity level — give a reason for each factor, not just a list. For nutritional analysis questions, name a specific method (food tables or software) and explain how the results would be used to improve a dish. Examiners reward precise nutritional data, not vague suggestions like “make it healthier.”
